annotation.title_clean: Informe artículo 74 Ley N° 20.212: Recomendaciones para una regulación de la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) orientada al desarrollo ético, la protección de los derechos humanos y el fomento de la innovación tecnológica
annotation.title_en: Article 74 Law No. 20.212 Report: Recommendations for a regulation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) oriented to ethical development, human rights protection and promotion of technological innovation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agesic (Áreas Secretaría Letrada y Sociedad de la Información), Uruguay
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Uruguay's Agesic report under Article 74 of Law 20.212 offers recommendations for AI regulation, covering governance institutions, human rights, intellectual property, cybersecurity, labour, civil liability, consumer rights and promotion measures, informed by international instruments and stakeholder input. It is general AI policy without robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Strengthen Agesic with a dedicated AI and Data structure and possibly a legal mandate
Institutionalise the Public Sector Strategic Committee for AI and Data
Sectoral entities should develop sectoral rules, monitoring and oversight
Special human rights protections, non-discrimination and accessible redress mechanisms
Legal certainty on civil liability and IP while avoiding over-regulation that burdens innovators
